symptom: Drag lags more as the page grows
likely_cause: layout reads or style changes on every move
first_fix: write a transform from the move handler and nothing else

symptom: Animation stutters only while the page loads
likely_cause: main thread busy, animation driven by script
first_fix: move to a CSS transition or WAAPI so the compositor runs it

symptom: Sidebar slide janks
first_fix: animate translateX

symptom: Every item re-renders during a drag
likely_cause: motion value held in framework state
first_fix: write the value straight to the element, or use a motion value

symptom: Blur makes frames drop
first_fix: blur small areas, short, or fade a pre-blurred layer

symptom: Whole subtree repaints on one change
likely_cause: an inherited CSS variable changed on a parent
first_fix: set the variable on the element that uses it

symptom: Memory climbs on a page of cards
first_fix: apply it just before the animation, remove after

symptom: Thousands of rows stagger slowly
first_fix: virtualise and animate only visible rows

symptom: Hover stays after tap
first_fix: gate hover with hover and fine pointer

symptom: Grey flash on tap
first_fix: transparent tap highlight plus own :active

symptom: Hero or bottom bar cut by the URL bar
first_fix: 100dvh for shells, 100svh for heroes

symptom: Page zooms on input focus
first_fix: 16 px minimum

symptom: Tap feels slow
first_fix: style :active, touch-action manipulation

symptom: Pulling down refreshes the page behind a sheet
first_fix: overscroll-behavior none on root, contain on scrollers

symptom: Header sits under the notch
likely_cause: no viewport-fit cover or no safe-area padding
first_fix: viewport-fit cover plus env() inset padding

symptom: Long press selects a button label
first_fix: user-select none on controls only

symptom: Carousel moves the page too
first_fix: touch-action pan-y or native scroll snap

symptom: Browser bar the wrong colour
first_fix: one meta per colour scheme

symptom: Reversing mid-animation looks wrong
first_fix: use transitions or springs that retarget from the current value

symptom: Dismiss gesture ignores a quick flick
first_fix: also decide by velocity sign at release

symptom: Drag ends with a hard stop at the edge
first_fix: damped resistance past the boundary

symptom: Popover grows from the wrong corner
first_fix: transform-origin at the trigger
